The '''''Raddaugh Gnasp'' fluttercraft''',<ref name="rebelsvisual" /> also known as '''Wookiee fluttercrafts''',<ref name="Ships and Vehicles II" /> were a well-known [[Wookiee]] vehicle manufactured by [[Appazanna Engineering Works]].<ref name="rebelsvisual" /> The fluttercraft were used by Wookiee [[soldier]]s during the [[Clone Wars]], and saw action during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>
